blocking: Header nav links to how-we-work.html and about.html, but neither file exists in the build (only index.html and weddings.html): two of three nav items 404 on every page.

fixes.what: Ship how-we-work.html and about.html (the CSS for .steps/.faq/.letter/.story already exists), or drop the two links until they exist.
fixes.why: Live 404s from the main nav are a launch blocker.

fixes.what: Skip setting src/srcset on leftBranch/rightBranch when !isDesktop() (or add loading="lazy" and a <picture> media query), since both branches are display:none under 768px.
fixes.why: Phones download ~250 KB of WebP they never paint.

fixes.what: Add srcset with 800w/1200w variants and sizes="(min-width:768px) 60vw, 100vw" to the four pom-*.jpg images; the closed desktop panels are ~90px wide yet load the full 1280x1920 (496 KB) files.
fixes.why: ~1.35 MB of JPEG for one strip; slow on mobile data.

fixes.what: Change left:-40px to left:-35px (or move .journey__line--v to left:6px) so the 14px dot centre (x=7) sits on the 2px line (x=11-13).
fixes.why: Dots visibly sit 5px left of the track line on phones.

fixes.what: Add integrity + crossorigin="anonymous" SRI hashes, or self-host the three pinned files in assets/js/vendor/.
fixes.why: Two third-party origins with no subresource integrity on a site that hides content until GSAP runs.

fixes.what: On Escape, return focus to .nav-toggle; also close the drawer on click outside and on resize to >=768px; add aria-hidden handling for the .site-nav when closed on mobile.
fixes.why: Keyboard users lose focus position when the drawer closes.
